subject: Portfolio Review Request – Mandate Alignment Ahead of 2026 University Fee Requirement
body:
Dear Ms. Rahman,

I hope this message finds you well.

As part of our ongoing oversight of your discretionary portfolio, we have identified two items that we believe warrant discussion at your earliest convenience.

First, our review has identified that two instruments currently held within the portfolio are not aligned with the binding exclusions set out in your mandate. As this is a discretionary portfolio managed under Julius Baer's authority, we take this matter seriously and would like to walk you through the specifics and the steps available to bring the portfolio back into alignment.

Second, the portfolio's current equity allocation stands at 67.74%, compared to the mandate's target band of 30–55% — a deviation of 13 percentage points above the upper limit. Given the SGD 180,000 in university fees for your children due on 1 September 2026 in Australia, we believe it is prudent to review the portfolio's positioning and liquidity planning well ahead of that date, to ensure the mandate continues to reflect your objectives and time horizon.

We would welcome the opportunity to meet with you — in person or by video call, whichever is more convenient — to discuss these points in detail and agree on any adjustments. Please let us know your availability over the coming days, and we will arrange a time at your convenience.

Thank you for your continued trust in Julius Baer. We look forward to speaking with you soon.

Kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
